name: Social Styles Profile
excerpt: The Social Styles Profile categorizes individuals as Drivers, Expressive, Analyticals, or Amiables.
notes: The Social Styles Profile is a framework for understanding interpersonal behavior. It categorizes individuals into four types: Drivers (proactive and task-oriented), Expressive (proactive and people-oriented), Analyticals (reactive and task-oriented), and Amiables (reactive and people-oriented).
context_summary:
- Categorizes individuals into four types: Drivers, Expressive, Analyticals, Amiables.
- Drivers are task-oriented; Expressive are people-oriented.
- Analyticals are reactive and task-oriented; Amiables are reactive and people-oriented.
